messages:
Mia_CS: quick heads up — Olivia caught sporadic p99 spikes on NovaCare after they increased context to ~512. worried this could surface in renewal conversations. :wave:
Olivia_PMT: saw it during last night's demo. p50 ~60ms, p95 ~170ms, p99 ~1.9s. usually around 200-300 tokens. traces show KV cache cold misses and a couple of timeouts.
Mia_CS: environment: hosted, model=open-xlarge-v1, routing=region-first, EU-West hot. no quantization enabled. mostly single-turn traffic with some follow-ups.
Raj_Infra: thanks. can you confirm whether these are steady-state or burst-related? and whether they reproduce in staging?
Olivia_PMT: reproduces on staging when we replay a production trace. bursts increase cold-starts for KV entries.
Mia_CS: I'd like to propose a conservative, reversible pilot to reduce tail risk before renewal call:
- enable aggressive prefix prefetch / KV warmup for session initiations
- hybrid routing: keep open-xlarge for short contexts (<=256) and route long-context generation to compact-v2 as a fallback
- trial INT8 balanced quant on a small dedicated canary slot off-peak to smooth latency and lower P99 variance
- pin routing to a dedicated EU slot during canary (no global failover)
Sam_SE: +1. also recommend adaptive batching with a latency cap (300ms) so short requests don't get held up. I'll run a 40-sample eval focusing on long-context QA, reranking, and multi-turn coherence to check for regressions.
Raj_Infra: proposed canary config snippet:
```
enable_prefix_cache: true
prefix_cache_ttl: 300s
fallback_model: compact-v2@2026-03
quant_profile: int8-balanced
route_policy: account-dedicated-eu (no-global-fallback)
batching: adaptive, latency_cap_ms: 300
canary_window: 2h
```
OpsBot: Canary scheduled: nova-prefetch-canary-2026-03-25T02:00Z. owners: Raj_Infra, Sam_SE. monitoring: token_latency, kv_hit_rate, cold_start_count, hallucination_rate.
Olivia_PMT: prefer starting on staging keys first, run eval, validate quality before touching production routing.
Mia_CS: plan: staging canary -> eval set -> short prod slice if green. Sam to own evals, Raj to provision slot and dashboards, Olivia to confirm staging creds.
Sam_SE: will prepare eval (40 samples) by EOD tomorrow with acceptance thresholds for latency and top-1 accuracy.
Raj_Infra: I'll reserve a 2-GPU slot in EU-West, enable the quant profile on the slot, and attach tracing. will share dashboard link here when ready.
Mia_CS: thanks all. please ping with green/red. goal is to reduce p99 spikes and avoid any renewal friction. :thumbsup:
